## Assignment Simulated Data

### 1. Prepare df
```{r}
set.seed(1)
n = 30 #sample size
ng = 2 #number of groups
p = 1000 #number of variables 

r = rnorm(n*ng*p, mean = 4, sd =2)

#putting data into a matrix
data = matrix(r, p, n*ng)
data

#put names on columns
#paste when I want to paste some numbers in a vector
#sep for separator
colnames(data) = c(paste("HD", 1:4, sep=""), paste("D", 1:4, sep=""))
rownames(data) = c(paste("protein", 1:p, sep=""))
data
```
